main_text.p: memoratas epilepsias. Primùm enim àre-centibus orditur, post quarū exacerbationes venam secat in cubiti flexura, si nihil impediat:Quòd si nihil remittat exacerbatio, extremas partes sinapismo integit, & cucurbitas praecordijs affigit: quibus si nò remittat,nihil spei relinqui ait: Veruntamē castorij per uim ori infundit, & cyrenai-cum succum,cum melle & aceto: & per se-dem infundit centaurij decoctum, aut co-locynthidis.Postea eos qui exurgunt, post refectionem,per hieram evacuat.Atq; hæc est recentis & acutæ epilepsiæ curatio,quā ille tradit. Vetere autem affectos diu similiter in aquæ potu continet, & in curatio-nis aggressione venam secat, si nihil prohibeat:& interpositis quatuor, aut quinque diebus corpus reficit: post medicamento purgante ipsum evacuat, maximè quidem veratro nigro,aut colocynthide, aut scam-monio.Manè verò passum evacuatum præbet. Post sufficientem purgationem ipsos lavat.Tertio die post praecordijs, ac dorso cucurbitas affigit cum incisione. Deinde multis diebus interpositis, & refecto cor-pore,hieram ex colocynthide exhibet:po-stea capiti ac occipiti cucurbitas affigit.

page.notes: Long s rendered as "f" in "Poft"/"fufficientem" transcribed as plain s. "Postea" and "post" in the scan are written with long s and read accordingly. "Veruntamē", "nò", "Manè", "ò" kept as printed. Line-end broken words without a printed hyphen written whole ("præbet"). Running head and catchword as printed; "CAVSAS" read as CAUSAS per the u/v rule.
